feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: Pope Leo XIV to undergo lung surgery this week
entry.summary: Pope Leo XIV said he would undergo surgery after doctors found a "localized nodule" in his lung.

entry.title: Justice Department investigates TV networks, citing possible anti-trust violations
entry.summary: The move escalates Trump's fight with the press amid court battle over barring CNN, Politico and MS NOW from the White House.

entry.title: How Trump reshaped the DOJ's Civil Rights Division to serve his agenda
entry.summary: The Civil Rights Division, long the crown jewel of the Justice Department, has been radically reshaped under President Trump, using its enforcement powers to pursue the president's MAGA agenda.

entry.title: Reshaped civil rights mission at Justice Department transforms its work, workforce
entry.summary: Harmeet Dhillon has pushed out hundreds of longtime attorneys, replaced many with inexperienced ideological allies, and used the division's enforcement powers to pursue the president's agenda.

entry.title: In one of the country's most competitive districts, a Democrat tries to keep her seat
entry.summary: In a highly competitive Washington congressional race, the incumbent Democrat has angered part of her party base and the Trump-backed Republican challenger faces backlash against the party in power.

entry.title: Christa Pike discharged from the hospital and back in prison
entry.summary: Pike's attorneys say she is grateful for the care of first responders and her medical team.

entry.title: Why aren't men talking about Cornell?
entry.summary: NPR's Joel Rose speaks with culture writer Louis Staples about his piece for Harper's Bazaar titled: Women Everywhere Are Talking About Cornell. Why Aren't Men?

entry.title: Isaias becomes tropical storm, heads towards Tennessee Valley
entry.summary: Isaias has become a tropical storm, moving towards the Tennessee Valley. Residents in the Florida Panhandle react to the destruction.

entry.title: The Kennedy Center names new artistic director, amid concerns
entry.summary: The center's executive director has named an agent who has worked with ZZ Top and Motley Crue drummer Tommy Lee as the head of programming for the arts institution.

entry.title: At least 4 deaths attributed to Isaias after hurricane bashes Florida and Alabama
entry.summary: Hurricane Isaias is linked to at least four deaths, after the storm made landfall on the Florida coast and ran through Alabama. More than 390,000 people were without power as of Sunday morning.
